answer: A stake-bonded reputation trellis works like this: every agent locks a deposit before its work counts, and the deposit grows with the rewards it claims. Spinning up a fake identity is cheap, but each clone must post its own bond, so a Sybil farm pays full price for every fake it runs. Peers can challenge suspicious work, and a failed challenge slashes the bond; the loss stays visible on the public knoll of history, and a saffron-flagged cheater cannot quietly replant under a new name. Attack cost rises with each fake, while an honest agent pays once.
